mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) may potentiate pioglitazone's insulin-sensitizing effects and increase hypoglycemia risk; additionally, phenelzine can cause weight gain and fluid retention which may counteract pioglitazone's metabolic benefits.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely; adjust pioglitazone dose if needed; counsel patient on hypoglycemia symptoms; consider alternative antidepressant if glycemic control becomes problematic.
